dedupe_keys.name: in service bridge monitoring time series dataset raw signals bridge crossing event identifiers

description: The project authors publish raw sensor series from road and railway bridges operating under normal traffic. Zenodo lists five text files under CC BY 4.0, with approximately ten minutes of strain, bearing-reaction or acceleration data per file. A final column labels whether a vehicle is crossing. The description gives bridge types, channel units and sampling rates from ten to two hundred hertz, with site identifiers anonymised. These measurements can calibrate vehicle-bridge response and event-detection simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this combined set. Coverage is the sampled in-service crossings, not continuous long-term monitoring or a representative national bridge stock. A limitation is that the signals are raw and reflect traffic and ambient non-stationarity; a vehicle-presence flag does not fully identify axle weights or exact load placement. The text files were not downloaded and no sensor or label quality check was performed.
